test.create_query: CREATE TABLE lazy_sort_t1 (c1 String, c2 Nullable(String), c3 Nullable(String), c4 Nullable(String), c5 Nullable(String), c6 Nullable(String), c7 Nullable(String), c8 Nullable(Float64), c9 Nullable(String), c10 Nullable(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1
CREATE TABLE lazy_sort_t2 (c1 String, c2 Nullable(UInt64)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1
CREATE TABLE lazy_sort_t3 (c1 String, c2 DateTime, c3 Nullable(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (c1, c2)
CREATE TABLE lazy_sort_dict (c1 String, v UInt32) ENGINE = Join(ALL, LEFT, c1)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO lazy_sort_t1 SELECT toString(number), if(number % 10 = 0, NULL, concat('u', toString(number), '@example.com')), concat('t', toString(number % 7)), concat('k', toString(number % 50)), concat('m', toString(number % 500)), if(number % 3 = 0, 'g', ''), concat('b', toString(number % 1000)), (number % 1000) / 10., 'x', 'p' FROM numbers(2000000)
INSERT INTO lazy_sort_t2 SELECT toString(number), number % 5 FROM numbers(2000000)
INSERT INTO lazy_sort_t3 SELECT toString(number % 2000000), toDateTime('2024-02-01 00:00:00') + number, concat('10.0.', toString(number % 256), '.', toString(number % 199)) FROM numbers(6000000)
INSERT INTO lazy_sort_dict SELECT toString(number % 2000000), toUInt32(number) FROM numbers(6000000)
test.query: SELECT t1.c1 AS a1, t1.c2 AS a2, t3.c3 AS a3, t1.c3 AS a4, t1.c4 AS a5, t1.c5 AS a6, t1.c6 AS a7, t1.c7 AS a8, t3.c2 AS a9, t1.c8 AS a10, t1.c9 AS a11 FROM lazy_sort_t1 AS t1 INNER JOIN lazy_sort_t2 AS t2 ON t2.c1 = t1.c1 INNER JOIN lazy_sort_t3 AS t3 ON t3.c1 = t1.c1 WHERE (t1.c2 NOT LIKE '%zzz%') AND (t1.c10 != 'q') AND (t2.c2 > 0) AND (t3.c2 >= '2024-01-01') AND (t3.c2 < today()) ORDER BY a9 ASC FORMAT Null SETTINGS query_plan_join_swap_table = false, enable_lazy_columns_replication = 0, query_plan_min_columns_for_join_lazy_indexing = 3
SELECT t1.c1, t1.c2, t1.c3, t1.c4, t1.c5, d.v FROM lazy_sort_t1 AS t1 ALL LEFT JOIN lazy_sort_dict AS d USING (c1) ORDER BY t1.c1 FORMAT Null SETTINGS enable_lazy_columns_replication = 1
SELECT t1.c1, t1.c2, t1.c3, t1.c4, t1.c5, d.v FROM lazy_sort_t1 AS t1 ALL LEFT JOIN lazy_sort_dict AS d USING (c1) ORDER BY t1.c1, d.v FORMAT Null SETTINGS enable_lazy_columns_replication = 1
